scenes.tts: Textbooks sort nociceptors into tidy bins. What are those bins actually measuring?
scenes.visual: Title card: Labels, Classes and States. A four-bin textbook figure that dissolves into three separate rulers.
scenes.narration: Textbooks sort nociceptors into tidy bins. What are those bins actually measuring?

scenes.tts: Three unrelated kinds of measurement are being mixed: a molecular label, a conduction class, and a functional state.
scenes.visual: Three rulers drawn in parallel: a gene marker, a velocity scale in metres per second, and a state switch.
scenes.narration: Three unrelated kinds of measurement are being mixed: a molecular label, a conduction class, and a functional state.

scenes.tts: A molecular label is a gene whose expression marks a population and gives genetic access to it.
scenes.visual: Two labelled populations in a ganglion: CGRP-positive peptidergic, and Mrgprd-positive binding IB4.
scenes.narration: A molecular label is a gene whose expression marks a population and gives genetic access to it.

scenes.tts: These are markers, not functions. C G R P is not a heat channel.
scenes.caption: These are markers, not functions. CGRP is not a heat channel.
scenes.visual: A marker tag beside a channel symbol, with a crossed-out equals sign between them.
scenes.narration: These are markers, not functions. CGRP is not a heat channel.

scenes.tts: A conduction class is a velocity measured from an axon.
scenes.visual: A spike travelling along an axon with a stopwatch and a velocity readout in metres per second.
scenes.narration: A conduction class is a velocity measured from an axon.

scenes.tts: Mouse high-threshold mechanonociceptors with circumferential hair-follicle endings carried a peptidergic label.
scenes.visual: An ending wrapping a hair follicle, labelled Calca; the gene label and the Aδ class drawn as crossing axes.
scenes.narration: Mouse high-threshold mechanonociceptors with circumferential hair-follicle endings carried a peptidergic label.

scenes.tts: Their label encodes alpha-C G R P, so a mechanonociceptor sits in a peptidergic class. The axes cross.
scenes.caption: Their label encodes alpha-CGRP, so a mechanonociceptor sits in a peptidergic class. The axes cross.
scenes.visual: The two rulers overlaid, with one neuron plotted on both at once.
scenes.narration: Their label encodes alpha-CGRP, so a mechanonociceptor sits in a peptidergic class. The axes cross.

scenes.tts: A functional state is something a neuron can change. Some labelled nociceptors were mechanically silent.
scenes.visual: A cultured neuron soma indented by a probe, with a flat current trace beside it. Label: CHRNA3-positive, mechanoinsensitive.
scenes.narration: A functional state is something a neuron can change. Some labelled nociceptors were mechanically silent.

scenes.tts: After a day with nerve growth factor, mechanically activated currents appeared.
scenes.visual: The same indentation now evokes an inward current. Label: 24 h, 50 ng/ml nerve growth factor.
scenes.narration: After a day with nerve growth factor, mechanically activated currents appeared.

scenes.tts: Knockdown of Pee-AY-zo two prevented them from appearing, so it was required for the change.
scenes.caption: Knockdown of PIEZO2 prevented them from appearing, so it was required for the change.
scenes.visual: A third condition with siRNA knockdown and no induced current. Label: PIEZO2 siRNA.
scenes.narration: Knockdown of PIEZO2 prevented them from appearing, so it was required for the change.

scenes.tts: In a dish, and in the soma rather than the ending. Neither result came from an intact ending.
scenes.visual: The culture dish and soma circled, an intact skin ending greyed out beside them with a caution tag.
scenes.narration: In a dish, and in the soma rather than the ending. Neither result came from an intact ending.

scenes.tts: Now remove a whole labelled population in an adult animal and test behaviour.
scenes.visual: A ganglion loses its Mrgprd-positive cells, with a toxin injection and a histology panel beside it.
scenes.narration: Now remove a whole labelled population in an adult animal and test behaviour.

scenes.tts: Histology showed that the treatment eliminated more than ninety-eight percent of the labelled cell bodies.
scenes.visual: The histology panel quantified. On screen: more than 98% of Mrgprd-positive somata gone.
scenes.narration: Histology showed that the treatment eliminated more than ninety-eight percent of the labelled cell bodies.

scenes.tts: Mechanical withdrawal threshold rose, while heat and cold responses were spared in the ranges tested.
scenes.visual: Three assay icons: a von Frey filament with a rising threshold bar, a hot plate and a cold plate unchanged.
scenes.narration: Mechanical withdrawal threshold rose, while heat and cold responses were spared in the ranges tested.

scenes.tts: A lesion of T R P V one-positive central branches did the opposite. Noxious heat responses went, and baseline mechanical thresholds were unchanged.
scenes.visual: The complementary lesion drawn at the central afferent branches, labelled by T R P V one expression, with a note that these branches transmit the signal rather than transduce heat at the skin. Heat responses gone; baseline mechanical bars unchanged.
scenes.narration: A lesion of TRPV1-positive central branches did the opposite. Noxious heat responses went, and baseline mechanical thresholds were unchanged.
scenes.caption: A lesion of TRPV1-positive central branches did the opposite. Noxious heat responses went, and baseline mechanical thresholds were unchanged.

scenes.tts: Read together, that is a functional dissociation in mice, in those stimulus ranges.
scenes.visual: The two lesions drawn as a two-by-two of modality against manipulation.
scenes.narration: Read together, that is a functional dissociation in mice, in those stimulus ranges.

scenes.tts: It is not evidence that every fibre is unimodal, nor that mouse withdrawal reports human pain.
scenes.visual: Two crossed-out claims on screen beside the two-by-two.
scenes.narration: It is not evidence that every fibre is unimodal, nor that mouse withdrawal reports human pain.

scenes.tts: Adult removal moved one modality. Predict what happens when the same neurons are deleted from birth.
scenes.visual: Two timelines side by side: deletion in the adult, and deletion from birth, the second outcome hidden.
scenes.narration: Adult removal moved one modality. Predict what happens when the same neurons are deleted from birth.

scenes.tts: Nothing detectable. The mice deleted from birth lacked a mechanical deficit in the later assays.
scenes.visual: The hidden outcome appears: thresholds unchanged. Label: read by the authors as compensation.
scenes.narration: Nothing detectable. The mice deleted from birth lacked a mechanical deficit in the later assays.

scenes.tts: So a germline deletion is a developmental experiment, and an adult manipulation asks a different question.
scenes.visual: The two timelines labelled: development can compensate; the adult circuit is tested as it stands.
scenes.narration: So a germline deletion is a developmental experiment, and an adult manipulation asks a different question.

scenes.tts: These mouse and cellular experiments measure channels, neurons and reflexes. The lesson's surgical trials measure what patients reported. Keep those levels of evidence distinct.
scenes.visual: Takeaway card: channel, neuron, behaviour, and separately a patient's own report. Pain is what the whole nervous system makes of them.
scenes.narration: These mouse and cellular experiments measure channels, neurons and reflexes. The lesson's surgical trials measure what patients reported. Keep those levels of evidence distinct.
